name: goofspiel4_fixed
description: Goofspiel with 4 cards, prize order fixed 1..4; simultaneous bids via infosets, bids revealed after each round, ties discard the prize, last round forced, payoff = p0 prize sum - p1 prize sum.
known_value_source: symmetric game (swapping the players maps the game to itself with negated payoff), so the value is 0; argument in games/other/README.md, certified exactly by solve.py
